newsitem.title: ITALY: Vranitzky meets Albanian rebels on Italian ship.
newsitem.headline: Vranitzky meets Albanian rebels on Italian ship.

text.p: European mediator Franz Vranitzky held shipboard talks with rebel representatives of 11 southern Albanian towns on Friday after meeting Prime Minister Bashkim Fino, the Italian foreign ministry said.

Both the meeting with Fino and the talks with representatives of the National Committee of Public Salvation, an umbrella grouping of rebel towns in the south, took place aboard the Italian frigate Aliseo in the Adriatic.
Diplomatic sources said Fino left the ship after his meeting with Vranitzky and did not meet directly with the rebel leaders.
"He (Fino) said he believed that dialogue (with the rebels) should take place with political forces and not members of the government," the diplomatic source said.

Vranitzky told Reuters earlier by telephone from the ship that he would urge the European Union and OSCE member states to consider sending military support to Albania to end spreading chaos and anarchy.
The Italian diplomatic sources said Fino had asked Europe for "several thousand men" to help Albania restore order.
Vranitzky told Reuters he was told by Fino, Foreign Minister Arjan Starova and army chief of staff General Adem Copani that they could not cope with the situation by themselves.
Vranitzky was due to hold a news conference in the Italian port city of Brindisi on Friday evening (1645 GMT).
